original_test_intent: Verify the platform-defined GPU/NVSwitch/NVLink fabric, including the source-required 144 GPU links, and post-test usability.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Run the applicable NVIDIA diagnostic/topology flow and enumerate the complete fabric.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: All expected GPUs, switches and links match the platform topology and the SUT remains workable.

historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED; required a generation-specific per-edge manifest rather than count-only proof.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Owner supplies platform generation, private tool profile and topology; collection is automatable after approval.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: Retain the 144-link source fact and original vendor tool.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Exact GPU/NVSwitch/port edge manifest and supported package.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: A count-only result cannot prove topology; platform-specific counts do not overwrite the Master.

original_method: Preserve the NVIDIA diagnostic and topology intent; do not infer GPU-index adjacency.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the qualified NVIDIA topology/FCT profile plus stable UUID/BDF/switch-port correlation.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable NVIDIA tool manual and platform topology recipe.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Private command semantics and generation maps cannot be guessed.

safety_boundaries: No active workload or unreviewed tool profile
expected_evidence: Full tool output and exit status
no_automatic_retry: Preserve any missing link or tool failure; no reset/rerun without approval.
review_improvement: V3 is retained because it already prevents cross-generation topology assumptions; V3.1 makes project mapping an input rather than a Master rewrite.
